title: Two Sum
description:
Given an array of integers and a target integer, find two numbers in the array that add up to the target.

Print the two 0-based indices, space-separated, with the smaller index first.

You may assume each input has exactly one solution and you may not use the same element twice.

Input Format:
  Line 1: Comma-separated integers (the array)
  Line 2: A single integer (the target)

Output Format:
  Two space-separated indices

Example:
  Input:
    2,7,11,15
    9
  Output:
    0 1
  Explanation: nums[0] + nums[1] = 2 + 7 = 9

starterCode.python:
# Read input
nums = list(map(int, input().split(',')))
target = int(input())

# Your solution here
